=== objects

object "Long" as o2
object o3 as "Long 3"
object "o4"

object o6 [[http://x]]

object A
=== object multiline

  name = "Dummy"
  id = 123
}

  -a = 1
}

  x = 1

}

}
=== maps
map m1 {
  key1 => value1
  key2 => value2
}
map "Display" as m2 {
  a => b
}
map m3 <<st>> #pink ##[dashed]blue {
  x => y
}
=== map links
class Target
map m1 {
  k1 => v1
  k2 *--> Target
  k3 *---> Target
}
=== map bad line
map m1 {
  no arrow here
}

  a => b
}

}

}
